format.inherits: cp3_golden part 1 and part 2 'format': presented 'value' (money ROUND_HALF_UP to the minor unit; ratios to 1e-12), 'exact' as a reduced fraction 'p/q' or integer string, 'window' {request, base, end, days}, 'detail' null = NOT ASSERTED, 'lineage_includes', value null iff INSUFFICIENT_DATA. Numbers are JSON strings parsed with Decimal or Fraction, never float.
format.lot_fields: A lot (in a lot_book) or a portion (in a relief) is {origin_event_id, carry, acquisition_date, date_kind, basis_currency, units, unit_cost, basis}. 'carry' is the ordered carry history (ledger-replay/1.4 0.5.1): a list of hops {from_account_id, out_event_id, in_event_id, date}; [] for a lot that never moved. date_kind is 'TRADE' (BUY), 'RECORDED' (OPENING_POSITION or external TRANSFER_IN carrying acquired_on; acquisition_date = acquired_on; ledger-replay/1.5 Ruling 0.6) or 'ENTRY' (the same events without acquired_on); a carried lot keeps its origin's. Events may carry the optional LedgerEvent field 'acquired_on' (an ISO date; PD-0036), only on OPENING_POSITION and external security TRANSFER_IN. basis_currency, unit_cost and basis are null for an unknown basis. units, unit_cost and basis are EXACT fraction strings (the fold never rounds). Lists of lots or portions are compared AS SETS keyed by (origin_event_id, the carry's out_event_ids).

kinds_added.lot_book: The FIFO-mode replay output for (account_id, listing_id) at (as_of, ledger_version): 'quantity' (exact) and 'lots' (the end-of-day lot book). No market data is read.
kinds_added.relief: The FIFO-mode relief record of one depleting event (SELL or TRANSFER_OUT, by event_id): 'portions' as relieved on its date (each event's share, ledger-replay/1.4 0.5.5). For an internal out-leg these are exactly the lots its in-leg delivers, before the hop is appended.
kinds_added.replay_basis: The replay state's emitted position basis in 'mode' NONE (ledger-replay/1.3, the CP1 'basis' kind) or FIFO (ledger-replay/1.4 0.5.11): value is a list of money objects sorted by currency, or null with reason and detail (ReplayDetail names).
kinds_added.realized_gain: performance Ruling 3.8 (with 1.5) for one SELL (event_id). view REPORTING (in the reporting currency) or NATIVE (in the sale's event currency, 'currency').
kinds_added.unrealized_gain: performance Ruling 3.9 for (account_id, listing_id) at as_of. view REPORTING, or NATIVE (in the listing's trading currency, 'currency').
kinds_added.remaining_basis: performance Ruling 3.9a (basis.remaining). view REPORTING: one value. view NATIVE: 'value' is a list of {currency, value, exact}, one per basis currency, compared as a set.
kinds_added.since_acquisition: performance Ruling 9.7 (with 1.5) for one lot ('lot': {origin_event_id, carry_out_event_ids}) at as_of, in the reporting currency: 'total' {value, exact} = the lot's UG_R; 'parts' in registry order LOCAL_AT_ACQUISITION_FX, FX_ON_COST, INTERACTION, each {line, exact, apportioned} where 'apportioned' is the Ruling 2.4 item 3 display value (the apportioned parts sum exactly to total.value).
kinds_added.realized_gain_total: performance Ruling 3.10 (with 1.5): sum of RG_R over sales dated in the window. When LIMITED, 'excluded_weight' {exact, value} is the gross proceeds weight of the excluded sales.
kinds_added.unrealized_gain_total: performance Ruling 3.10: sum of UG_R over positions at as_of. When LIMITED, 'excluded_weight' {exact, value} is the gross market-value weight of the excluded positions.

format.detail_names: performance/1.5: UNKNOWN_BASIS, ACQUISITION_DATE_UNKNOWN, MIXED_CURRENCY_BASIS (gains and basis); ReplayDetail names for replay_basis (LOT_DEPLETION). SOURCE_CONFLICT items leave detail null (a CP2 lineage cause), as in part 2; SPLIT_SUPPRESSION_CARRIED is asserted through lineage_includes where the carried taint is the point.
format.engine_metric_ids: As in parts 1 and 2: the loader maps kinds to the engine's metric ids; a rename is a mapping change, not a fixture change.

portfolios.name: P17 (a carried split taint ended by FIFO relief)

assertions.purpose: V1 held 100 SYNT at the start of the ex-date 03-03; no ledger SPLIT in W(K): NOT_RECORDED, append barred (synthetic evidence). V2 held none at 03-03 and is not subject to detection.

The 03-05 move out of V1 (suppressed since 03-03) carries a tainted lot s' (40 at 80, dated 02-03). V2 holds it beside its own lot v: V2's holding is INSUFFICIENT_DATA + SOURCE_CONFLICT (carried taint), and so is its remaining basis (Ruling 3.9a).

V2's SELL 40 relieves s' whole (02-03 is older than v's 03-04): the last tainted unit is relieved on 03-10. The sale relieves tainted units, so its realized gain is SOURCE_CONFLICT (Ruling 3.8 (1.5)). V2's end-of-day lot book holds only v, so its holding is valued: 100 x 20.00 = 2,000.00 AVAILABLE (Ruling 1.1a). The conservative rule would keep V2 suppressed (it never ends a day at 0).

After the taint ends: V2 valued (2,000.00), UG 2,000 - 1,950 = 50, remaining basis 1,950. V1 is still suppressed (its own NOT_RECORDED suppression is open-ended), so the portfolio total stays INSUFFICIENT_DATA + SOURCE_CONFLICT.

structural_assertions.statement: Every result computed against this fixture's market data is marked synthetic (market-data Ruling 4.8), and every manifest cites the ids in 'convention_sets' (FIFO-mode state: ledger-replay/1.4 + FIFO/1; replay_basis NONE items: ledger-replay/1.3).

Identity I-5 (lot conservation), exactly, for every relief in this fixture: relieved + remaining = the candidate set, per lot and per basis currency; and for every internal pair, the in-leg delivers exactly the out-leg's portions (units, basis, currency, acquisition date, date kind, known/unknown), with one hop appended.

Identity I-7 (method independence: RG + UG = proceeds + MV - costs), exactly, for P1 A3 MSFT at 2025-06-30 (120 + 80 = 1,720 + 2,580 - 4,100), P14 and P15 at 2025-03-31 (118 + 132), P16 at portfolio level at 2025-03-31 (1,544/3 + 436/3 = 660), and P19 at 2025-03-31 under both L = 4 (300 + 200) and L = 6 (100 + 180).
Identity I-8: every AVAILABLE since_acquisition's exact parts sum to its exact total, and its apportioned parts sum to total.value exactly.

Entry-order independence (performance Ruling 11.3 item 1; ledger-replay/1.4 0.5.4 and 0.5.6): P14 and P15 differ only in the ledger_seq order of their 2025-03-05 events, and every expected value is identical (only event ids differ). Also, permuting ledger_seq within any day of any part-3 portfolio changes no output byte, carry histories included.

Mode consistency (ledger-replay/1.4 0.5.13): replaying every part-3 portfolio in the none mode gives the ledger-replay/1.3 output (cp1_golden/1.1 still passes unchanged); wherever that output emits a determinate basis, the FIFO mode emits the same value; quantities, cash and flags are identical in both modes.
Determinism: byte-identical lot books, relief records and gain results across runs, processes and PYTHONHASHSEED values.
